script.t: Hi, this is Karen from Brightline Dental. We ordered twenty boxes of printer paper from your store last week, but we've only received ten.
I'm sorry about that. Let me check your order. It looks like the other ten boxes were sent to our warehouse by mistake.
We really need the paper by Friday. We're printing reminder letters for our patients' appointments next month.
Of course. I'll have the boxes delivered to your office tomorrow morning, and I'll take fifteen percent off your next order for the inconvenience.
Hello, Mr. Alvarez? This is Fiona Clarke from Redwood Engineering. I'm calling about the project coordinator position you applied for.
Oh, hello. Thanks for getting back to me.
We'd like to invite you for an interview next week. Would Tuesday at ten work for you?
I'm afraid I have a training course all day Tuesday. Is Wednesday possible?
Wednesday morning is fine. Please bring copies of your certifications, and plan to stay about two hours. You'll also meet the team you'd be working with.
Good afternoon, Harbor Grill. How can I help you?
Hi, I'd like to book a table for eight on Friday evening. It's a dinner with some clients, so we'd prefer somewhere quiet.
Let me see. We have a private room upstairs that seats up to ten. There's a forty-dollar room fee, though.
That's fine. Could you also tell me whether you have vegetarian options? Two of our guests don't eat meat.
Yes, our chef prepares a vegetarian tasting menu. I can e-mail you the menu so you can share it with your guests.
Hi, Raj. My laptop keeps shutting down whenever I open the design software, and I have a client presentation at three.
That sounds like the memory problem we've seen on some older models. Is yours one of the gray ones from 2022?
Yes, it is. Can you fix it before this afternoon?
Replacing the memory takes a day, but I can lend you one of our spare laptops right now. I'll copy your presentation files onto it.
Perfect. I'll bring mine to your office in ten minutes.

I'll be at work then. Could he use the spare key you keep in the office?
Yes, if you sign a permission form. I can e-mail it to you now, and you can send it back before tonight.
Hi, I'm trying to register for the marketing conference, but the Web site says the early-bird rate ended yesterday.

script.t: Look at the picture.

options.text: Several bicycles are parked in a row.
A cyclist is riding along the path.
The bicycles have been loaded onto a truck.

items.explanation: La foto muestra bicicletas quietas, una al lado de la otra: “parked in a row” lo describe exactamente.

a.why: “are being repaired” (pasiva en progreso) exige que alguien las esté reparando en ese momento. No hay personas en la foto.

c.why: Menciona a un ciclista. En la foto no hay nadie; la palabra “cyclist” se parece a “bicycles” para atraerte.

d.why: No se ve ningún camión. Es una suposición que la imagen no respalda.

confusion: Pasiva en progreso: solo es correcta si se ve la acción ocurriendo.
items.strategy: En la Parte 1, antes de oír las opciones, preguntate: ¿hay personas? ¿qué están haciendo? ¿qué objetos y en qué posición? Descartá toda opción con personas o acciones que no se ven.

items.explanation: El hombre sostiene una caja y la está poniendo sobre el carrito: “placing a box on a cart”.

a.why: Usa el objeto correcto (box) con una acción equivocada (opening with a knife).

c.why: “stacking” suena a una acción de bodega, pero los objetos son sillas y no aparecen.

d.why: Los estantes ya están instalados; nadie los está instalando.

items.strategy: Cuando hay una persona, el verbo principal casi siempre decide la respuesta. Escuchá el verbo antes que el objeto.
